{{Quote|The historical records will claim that the Rebel Alliance was born on Corellia. That ''is'' a documented fact. But the ''truth'' is this: The Rebel Alliance was born somewhere in the Scarl system aboard Darth Vader's personal starship, the ''Executor''.|[[PROXY]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (comic)">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref>}}
The '''Scarl system''' was a secluded [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], just [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. It was on the restricted [[Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
After the failure of the [[Sarlacc Project]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] installed a secret [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], [[Scarl]], in this [[Star system/Legends|system]] where began the construction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="TEA" />

It was from the still under construction ''Executor'' that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched his secret apprentice [[Galen Marek]] on a number of missions in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
